explainer_content.short_definition: Post-2000 acoustic indie music ranging from hushed cabin intimacy to festival folk-pop hooks.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Modern indie folk grew as alternative audiences rediscovered banjos, harmonies, acoustic guitars, and rustic imagery through indie labels, blogs, festivals, and streaming.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It made folk textures newly mainstream for millennial listeners and created a bridge between indie rock and adult acoustic pop.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: Old instruments are framed with modern indie dynamics: roomy recordings, gang vocals, stomps, and emotional restraint or release.

canonical_example_rationales.why_this_example_matters: Mumford & Sons anchors Modern indie folk and folk-pop by making story-first lyrics and twang or pedal-steel color easier to hear.
The Lumineers anchors Modern indie folk and folk-pop by making twang or pedal-steel color and dance or ballad pacing easier to hear.
Sigh No More - Mumford & Sons anchors Modern indie folk and folk-pop by making dance or ballad pacing and plainspoken vocal stance easier to hear.
